page.layout: One column of running text. Faint, partly illegible fragments of marginal notes at the left edge, bled through from the adjacent page. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: defertis commodissimis locis , quibus morari Romanos & transitu prohibere potuisset, satis trepidè Scarpheam se recepit. Verum priusquam istuc pertingeret, à Metello sequente occupatus, & prælio certare coactus est. In eo amissis suorum plurimis , captis etiam haud paucioribus ipse quoque periit , ferox ante pericula, in periculis animo abjecto & nullius consilii. Arcadum manus leētissima Critolaum secuta è fugâ Elateam primum delata, atque inde Peloponnesum petens, cum ad Chæroneam Bœotiæ in exercitum Metelli incidisset, ad internecionem delēta est. Critolao imperator ab Achæis furrogatus Diæus , æque vesanus, vocatis ad pileum servis, & ex Achaiâ atque Arcadiâ confecto rursum exercitu tumultuario, in quo ex omni hominum genere erant equites D c , pedites armaturæ gravis quater decies mille, ex his quater mille confilio absurdissimo Megaram misit ad eam urbem prædidio infidendam contra Romanos,& simul eorum iter in Peloponnesum impedistius faciendum. Metellus autem cum [illegible, ~4 letters]citu, partâ ad Chæroneam victo-riâ Thebas se contulit, omni ferè [?] vacuas. Nam civium bo[illegible, ~6 letters]rs Heracleæ in Thessaliâ aberat

page.notes: Line-end and left-edge fragments are unreadable and are marked as illegible. The left-margin marginal notes are bled through and mostly not legible, so none are transcribed as notes. The word "Metelli" is set in italic in the scan, and "delēta" appears with a macron-like mark over e. Printed "D c" is kept as printed. The catchword "cum" is at lower right and is not repeated in the text. Several words on lines with a left-margin overlap ("exercitu", "Thebas", "ignatore") are uncertain and need checking against a clearer scan.
